adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained positive shift in N and E (≈12–14 mm) beginning near index 532, persisting through ~585, then returning toward pre-event levels by index 587–590. U shows smaller but coherent negative offset (~−1 to −2 mm) during same interval. Both P1 (532–587) and P2 (534–585) capture this platform, but P1 better aligns with onset (sharp jump at 532) and return (gradual recovery ending ~587). Interior observations (e.g., indices 540–580) are stable and elevated, supporting a genuine temporary platform. No independent permanent step is evident within the interval; motion is smooth outside. Thus only P1 is genuine; P2 is redundant/overlapping.
